transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve gotten really slowed down. At work, I’ll sit there staring at one audit workpaper for like twenty minutes before I even move my hand to type anything. People are starting to notice I’m not keeping up, and that scared me enough to come in.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?
Yeah. Most days I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest, like the whole day is already ruined before I even get out of bed.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?
Not really. I used to plan hikes, take photos, cook on Sundays, volunteer at the library… and now all of that just feels like chores on a checklist. I don’t even care enough to start most of it.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
I don’t know. I wouldn’t say anxious exactly… mostly I just feel drained and stuck. I haven’t really noticed being on edge in the usual sense.
Have you been having any problems with your sleep?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I haven’t been paying close attention to it. Some nights feel worse than others, but I don’t know if I’d call it a specific sleep problem.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?

Not really. I keep thinking maybe I’ll enjoy hiking or taking photos again, or cooking on Sundays, but when it comes down to it, it just feels like another thing on a list. Even volunteering at the library… I don’t feel much interest in starting any of it.
Do you often feel guilty or blame yourself for things?

Yes. I feel like everything is my fault. Even when my husband shows me the bank balance and says we’re okay, I still feel certain I’ve ruined us financially. And at work, my manager tells me my job isn’t in danger, but I can’t shake the feeling that the firm is quietly building a case to show everyone I’m incompetent.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself?
I… I don’t really know how to answer that. I haven’t been keeping track of thoughts like that. I don’t think I’ve made any kind of plan or anything, but I’m not sure what counts as “hurting myself.”
How long have you been feeling this heavy, hollow feeling in your chest?
About seven months, I think. It started around when my husband stopped working after the downsizing, and it just hasn’t really lifted since then.
Have you experienced any strange or unusual thoughts, like hearing voices or seeing things that others can't?

Yes… sometimes. It’s mostly when I open a spreadsheet or my email. I’ll hear a clear voice, like it’s coming from just behind my laptop, saying, “You missed it, they know.” But there’s no one else in the room when it happens.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your appetite?

Yes. I don’t really feel hungry much anymore. Food is mostly just something I make myself eat because I know I should. And my work skirts have been getting loose, even though I’m not trying to lose weight.
Have you been feeling restless or fidgety, or have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual?

Yes… more slowed down than restless. I’ll sit there staring at the same audit workpaper for twenty minutes and not even move my hand to start typing. It’s gotten bad enough that people at work have noticed I’m not keeping up.
Have you been having any thoughts that you think are not your own or that are not based in reality?

Yes. I know it sounds unreasonable, but I can’t get past this feeling that I’ve already ruined us financially. My husband will show me the bank balance and say we’re okay, but I still feel certain it’s not true.

And at work, even when my manager says my job isn’t in danger, I keep thinking the firm is quietly collecting evidence to show everyone I’m incompetent. I can’t shake it.
Have you been experiencing any hallucinations or delusions regularly over the past two weeks?

Yes… I don’t think I’m seeing or hearing things, but I do keep having these beliefs I can’t shake. Even when my husband shows me the bank balance, I still feel certain I’ve ruined us financially. And even when my manager tells me my job isn’t in danger, I keep thinking the firm is quietly building a case to expose me as incompetent.
Have you been hearing voices or seeing things that others can't over the past two weeks?

Yes… I’ve been hearing a voice sometimes. It happens when I open a spreadsheet or my email. It sounds clear, like it’s coming from just behind my laptop, saying, “You missed it, they know.” But there’s no one else in the room.
Do you find it difficult to express your thoughts or follow a conversation lately?

I’m not sure. I don’t think I’m having trouble following conversations exactly. I can answer people, but sometimes I get quiet because I’m stuck in my own head or worried about what I’m saying. But I haven’t noticed my words coming out wrong or anything like that.
Do you find yourself having trouble organizing your thoughts or putting them into words?
Not really, no. I mean, I get slowed down because I’m anxious or distracted, but I can usually put my thoughts into words. I haven’t noticed them being disorganized exactly.
Do you find your thoughts are disjointed or hard to connect logically?
No, I don’t think so. My thoughts feel heavy or stuck sometimes, but they still make sense to me. I don’t think they’re jumping around or disconnected.
Do you find it hard to stay on topic when talking to someone?
I don’t think so. I might get quiet or lose my train of thought for a second, but I’m usually able to stay with what we’re talking about.
